workload.kind: Actual Qwen three-turn coding seed replay plus separate synthetic faults

interpretation: This is one workstation, sequential single repetitions; no fleet-wide causal claim.
Useful throughput is measured at the stated offered load, not an estimate of maximum capacity.
Raw committed input bytes may include skipped records; useful audit output is counted independently.
Unterminated tail rereads remain unfixed; read bytes are attributed by scenario.
Native windows use original ten-minute reporting; startup-mixed windows are excluded.
Preload phase strings are not used; driver timestamps define authoritative phases.
A separate fresh Qwen/cloud validation ran concurrently during part of the fixed measurement; shared-host interference is not controlled.
